New Patent Strengthens Cingulate’s Intellectual Property Portfolio While Company Maintains Focus on Advancing Lead ADHD Candidate CTx-1301

KANSAS CITY, Kan., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cingulate Inc. (NASDAQ: CING), a biopharmaceutical company utilizing its proprietary Precision Timed Release™ (PTR™) drug delivery platform to develop a pipeline of next-generation pharmaceutical products, today announced that the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) has issued U.S. Patent No. 12,797,335, titled "Trimodal, Precision-Timed Release Tablet."

The newly issued patent covers a buspirone tablet formulation incorporating Cingulate's proprietary PTR™ technology, which is designed to release medication at three separate, predetermined times throughout the day from a single tablet. Buspirone is an FDA-approved treatment for anxiety disorders. The patented formulation supports the Company's development of CTx-2103 and further demonstrates the versatility and broader applicability of Cingulate's technology beyond its initial focus on ADHD.

"Cingulate remains focused on advancing CTx-1301, our lead ADHD treatment candidate, toward NDA resubmission and commercialization in the second half of 2027, if approved. We believe CTx-2103 represents an attractive opportunity to build a pipeline of assets beyond ADHD with our proprietary PTR™ Platform. The issuance of this patent further strengthens the Company’s intellectual property portfolio. Following approval of CTx-1301, Cingulate anticipates initiating the development of CTx-2103," said Cingulate Chairman and CEO Shane J. Schaffer.

About U.S. Patent No. 12,797,335

U.S. Patent No. 12,797,335, titled "Trimodal, Precision-Timed Release Tablet," was issued by the United States Patent and Trademark Office on November 17, 2026. The patent covers a pharmaceutical tablet formulation designed to deliver three separate releases of an active pharmaceutical ingredient at predetermined intervals following administration. The patented technology utilizes Cingulate's proprietary Precision Timed Release™ (PTR™) approach to control the timing of medication release from a single oral dosage form. The patent covers a buspirone formulation relevant to Cingulate's investigational CTx-2103 candidate for the treatment of anxiety disorders and further expands the Company's intellectual property portfolio surrounding its proprietary drug delivery technology.

About Anxiety

Anxiety disorders are the most common category of mental disorders in the United States, affecting nearly 30 percent of adults at some point during their lives, according to the American Psychiatric Association.¹ Anxiety is a normal response to stress or perceived danger and can help individuals prepare for challenging situations. However, when excessive anxiety becomes persistent, difficult to control, and interferes with everyday activities, it may constitute an anxiety disorder.² According to the National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH), an estimated 31.1 percent of U.S. adults experience an anxiety disorder at some point during their lives.³ Despite the availability of effective treatments, anxiety disorders frequently go undiagnosed or untreated, with research indicating that delays between the onset of symptoms and initial treatment can extend for many years.⁴ The COVID-19 pandemic further highlighted the growing burden of mental health conditions, with the World Health Organization reporting a 25 percent increase in the global prevalence of anxiety and depression during the first year of the pandemic.⁵

About CTx-2103

CTx-2103 utilizes a novel multi-core formulation of buspirone, an FDA-approved treatment for anxiety.

CTx-2103 will be designed as a once-daily, modified-release tablet with clear differentiation and compelling advantages over standard treatment options which must be taken multiple times per day to maximize efficacy.

Cingulate completed a proof-of-concept study in which pharmacokinetics were evaluated for a trimodal tablet providing three precisely timed doses of buspirone. In addition, scintigraphic imaging visualized transit of the tablet through the gastrointestinal tract to confirm both the site and onset of release, which was then correlated with pharmacokinetic data to establish the full release profile of the CTx-2103 formulation. Based on the pharmacokinetic profile seen in the data, CTx-2103 achieved a triple release of buspirone. These results provided the critical information required to complete a Pre-IND meeting with FDA to discuss the design of the clinical and regulatory program.

About Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)

ADHD is a chronic neurobiological and developmental disorder that affects millions of children and often continues into adulthood. The estimated market size of the US ADHD market is approximately 100 million annual prescriptions. The condition is marked by an ongoing pattern of inattention and/or hyperactivity-impulsivity that interferes with functioning or development. In the U.S., over 20 million patients have been diagnosed with ADHD. Among this group, 12 million are adults and over 8 million are under the age of 17. According to the CDC, just 53.6 percent of all children and teens with ADHD reported they were actively treating their symptoms with medication in 2022, with 65-90 percent demonstrating clinical ADHD symptoms that persist into adulthood. Current market trends demonstrate that adult ADHD prevalence is larger and growing faster than the child and adolescent segments combined.

About CTx-1301

CTx-1301 (dexmethylphenidate HCl) is a once-daily, multi-core tablet utilizing Cingulate’s proprietary Precision Timed Release™ (PTR™) platform to deliver three precisely timed releases of active medication across the day. This design aims to provide rapid onset of effect and entire active-day duration. CTx-1301 is being evaluated for the treatment of ADHD under the FDA’s 505(b)(2) pathway. In October 2025, the FDA accepted for review the NDA for CTx-1301 and assigned a PDUFA target action date of May 31, 2026. On June 1, 2026, the FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for the CTx-1301 NDA; the Company and its CDMO have since substantially completed the manufacturing work required to address the CMC requests, and the Company expects to resubmit the NDA between December 2026 and January 2026. There can be no assurance regarding the timing of any resubmission or whether approval will occur.

About Precision Timed Release™ (PTR™) Platform Technology

Cingulate is developing ADHD and anxiety disorder product candidates capable of achieving true once-daily dosing using Cingulate’s innovative PTR drug delivery platform technology. It incorporates a proprietary Erosion Barrier Layer (EBL) providing control of drug release at precise, pre-defined times with no release of drug prior to the intended release. The EBL technology is enrobed around a drug-containing core to give a tablet-in-tablet dose form. It is designed to erode at a controlled rate until eventually the drug is released from the core tablet. The EBL formulation, Oralogik™, is licensed from BDD Pharma. Cingulate intends to utilize its PTR technology to expand and augment its clinical-stage pipeline by identifying and developing additional product candidates in other therapeutic areas in addition to Anxiety and ADHD.

About Cingulate Inc.

Cingulate Inc. (NASDAQ: CING) is a biopharmaceutical company utilizing its proprietary PTR drug delivery platform technology to build and advance a pipeline of next-generation pharmaceutical products, designed to improve the lives of patients suffering from frequently diagnosed conditions characterized by burdensome daily dosing regimens and suboptimal treatment outcomes. With an initial focus on the treatment of ADHD, Cingulate is identifying and evaluating additional therapeutic areas where PTR technology may be employed to develop future product candidates, including to treat anxiety disorders. Cingulate is headquartered in Kansas City. For more information, visit Cingulate.com.

Subscription agreement with Hong Kong-based Robinhood Ventures Limited for 10,000,000 Class B ordinary shares

SINGAPORE, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd (Nasdaq: TDTH) (“Trident” or the “Company”), a Singapore-headquartered digital infrastructure and technology holding company, today announced that it has entered into a subscription agreement (the “Subscription Agreement”) with Robinhood Ventures Limited (the “Purchaser”), a Hong Kong-incorporated investment holding company, for a private placement of 10,000,000 Class B ordinary shares of the Company (the “Shares”) at a purchase price of US$1.50 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of US$15,000,000 (the “Private Placement”).

The Company intends to use the proceeds of the Private Placement to partially fund its contemplated acquisition of the controlling stake (the “Acquisition Transaction”) in Guang Yao Development (M) Sdn. Bhd. (“Guang Yao”), a Malaysian company positioned to develop and provide hydrogen power and battery energy storage solutions for data centres, as previously announced by the Company, and partially for its general corporate purposes. The closing of the Private Placement is not conditional on the completion of that Acquisition Transaction, which may or may not be consummated in a timely manner or at all. If the proposed Acquisition Transaction is not completed, the Company intends to use all of the net proceeds of the Private Placement for working capital and general corporate purposes.

“I believe that this financing will provide Trident the capital to pursue our entry into the energy infrastructure that powers data centres,” said Soon Huat Lim, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Trident. “We are pleased to welcome Robinhood Ventures as an investor, and we believe its commitment reflects confidence in the direction we are taking the Company.”

Key Terms of the Private Placement

  • Shares and price: 10,000,000 Class B ordinary shares at US$1.50 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of US$15.0 million.
  • Fixed purchase price: the aggregate purchase price of US$15.0 million is fixed. If a share consolidation, share split, share dividend or similar transaction takes effect before the Shares are issued, the number of Shares and the per-share price will be adjusted proportionately.
  • Closing: expected to occur on the third business day after the closing conditions have been satisfied or waived, and not earlier than fifteen calendar days after the Company submits its Listing of Additional Shares notification to The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC. Closing is targeted for on or before January 8, 2027. Either party may terminate the Subscription Agreement if closing has not occurred by January 18, 2027, unless the failure to close is primarily attributable to that party’s breach.
  • Conditions: customary closing conditions, including the completion of know-your-customer, anti-money-laundering and sanctions checks, receipt of the purchase price in cleared funds, and receipt of all required corporate, regulatory and stock exchange approvals.
  • Registration right: the Purchaser may, on one occasion after the expiration of the applicable Regulation S distribution compliance period and before the six-month anniversary of the date of the Subscription Agreement, request that the Company use commercially reasonable efforts to file a registration statement for the resale of the Shares within 60 days, subject to the Company’s right to defer filing for up to 90 days.

Capital for the Next Stage of Growth

The Private Placement builds on the steps Trident has taken in 2026 to strengthen its balance sheet, including the conversion of US$11 million of founder’s loans into equity, and provides funding for the Company’s planned expansion into energy solutions for data centres. It complements Trident’s existing operating platforms, which include TDTHAI, the Company’s enterprise artificial intelligence business; the IRMA Engine Asia joint venture with Digital Innovations Group; and Trident Aliska Digital Tech Ghana Ltd., which operates the Sikaflow platform and supports the Ghana Revenue Authority digital tax platform.

The Shares are being offered and sold in an offshore transaction outside the United States in reliance on the exemption from registration provided by Regulation S under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”). No directed selling efforts (as defined in Regulation S) have been or will be made in the United States with respect to the Shares. The Shares have not been registered under the Securities Act or any state securities laws and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from the registration requirements. The Shares will be restricted securities and may not be resold except in compliance with applicable securities laws. This press release does not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any securities, nor shall there be any sale of these securities in any state or jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful.

Additional details regarding the Private Placement will be available in the Company’s Report on Form 6-K to be filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd is a Singapore-headquartered digital infrastructure holding company focused on building and operating sovereign-scale technology platforms across emerging markets. The Company’s businesses include TDTHAI, its enterprise artificial intelligence platform, and the IRMA Engine Asia joint venture. Through Trident Aliska Digital Tech Ghana Ltd., the Company operates the Sikaflow platform and supports the Ghana Revenue Authority digital tax platform launched on June 24, 2026.   • After hundreds of thousands entered Lukáš Chalabala from Prague, Czech Republic has been named the Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket holder for the 2027 calendar.
  • The Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket gives Lukáš and a guest access to every race on the calendar with flights and accommodation included.
  • He was handed the ticket by Heineken 0.0® ambassador Max Verstappen and this years’ holder Brandon Burgess at the Heineken® Las Vegas Grand Prix.

LAS VEGAS, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Heineken® has revealed Czech F1 fan Lukáš Chalabala as the winner of the Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket - a limited edition 1/1 - securing him access to every single race on the 2027 calendar.

Throughout the season, Lukáš will get the chance to travel the world and connect with the sport’s passionate fan community at every single stop, experiencing the best of F1. He and a guest will have access to the best grandstand seats, travel and accommodation covered worldwide by Heineken®.

Lukáš - who had never before experienced the thrill of F1 racing in person - was handed the one-of-a-kind carbon fibre pass by Brandon Burgess, the inaugural Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket holder at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. In a full-circle moment, the pair were surprised by four-time F1® world champion and Heineken® 0.0 ambassador Max Verstappen who presented Brandon with the inaugural ticket back in 2025.

The search for the 2027 Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket holder began in July, and attracted hundreds of thousands of fans. After reaching the final, along with five others from the UK, US, New Zealand and Singapore, Lukáš won the fan vote - hosted on F1® Unlocked.

Lukáš Chalabala, 2027 Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket holder says, “I’ve been a fan of F1 for as long as I can remember, but I’ve never had the chance to experience a race in person, so to win something like this is a dream come true. I said in my submission video that winning the Season Ticket would finally give my sofa some peace, so hopefully I won’t be using it too much next year! I’m most looking forward to experiencing every single race weekend up close and meeting fellow F1 fans from all over the world along the way. Twenty-four races, different cultures and countless unforgettable moments - I still can’t quite believe it’s actually happening! Knowing how many fans voted for me online feels surreal, and I want to make sure I give something back by taking them along on this incredible journey and sharing as much of the experience as I can.”

Brandon Burgess, 2026 Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket holder says, “I’ve had such an incredible year with this ticket, so I’m beyond excited to pass the experience onto another huge F1® fan. Having met so many great people and having made countless memories, all of which I'll remember for the rest of my life, I know that Lukáš has got a lot to look forward to, and I’m already excited to follow his journey with the ticket-of-a-lifetime next year!”

Four-time world champion and Heineken® 0.0 Ambassador, Max Verstappen says, “The Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket is the coolest opportunity I’ve seen for an F1 fan. Having the chance to experience every Grand Prix across the season is incredibly rare, and Lukáš will get to see so much more than just the racing. Being at every race will give him a unique insight into the sport, understanding the details and decisions that go into a race weekend whilst meeting new people along the way. He’ll also get to explore the cities and experience the culture of each place, which is something I don’t always get the chance to do myself when travelling from race to race. It’s a truly special way to experience Formula 1, both on and off the track.”

Nabil Nasser, Global Head of Heineken® says, “The Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket is about more than having a ticket to every race. It’s a chance to experience a full season through the people, places and moments that make F1® fandom so special and I’m delighted we’ve found a worthy successor in Lukás. In 2027, Lukás will experience the sport he loves in a way few others ever will, spending the year at the heart of F1® and making new connections with fans from around the world along the way.”

The Heineken® x F1® Season Ticket builds on the brand’s long-standing partnership with Formula 1® by continuing to evolve how the brand brings fans closer to the sport and celebrating the power of new connections created through fandom. Through F1® Fanzones presented by Heineken® 0.0, global activations, F1® Arcade experiences, and year-round content and campaigns, Heineken’s partnership with F1® brings its global sponsorship platform, Fans Have More Friends, to life, championing the idea that fandom is better when shared, especially over a Heineken®.

At the Heineken® Las Vegas Grand Prix this weekend, fans will have the chance to take part in The Social Upgrade, a content-led challenge that rewards those who can form an instant connection with other fans with exclusive upgrades and once-in-a-lifetime experiences.

Also available is a new Heineken® Studio signature serve: Lager Tonic. Taking inspiration from Max Verstappen’s personal taste, it combines the classic refreshing taste of Heineken with a tonic-infused foam top resulting in dry, citrusy, and bitter notes for an unexpectedly crisp and refreshing drinking experience. Heineken® Studio is the innovation playground from Heineken®, that explores new ideas and creates exciting experiences that bring people together in fresh and unexpected ways.

Heineken® will also feature on the Las Vegas Sphere with a creative concept that places the iconic Heineken® 0.0 bottle at the centre of a Las Vegas-inspired racetrack in a city transformed into a Heineken world.

Working together on technology, training, research and threat intelligence

MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--SentinelOne® (NYSE: S), the AI Security leader, today announced it will partner with the Defence Cyber Command (DCCOM) of the Digital and Intelligence (DIS) to collaboratively strengthen cyber defence and advance secure AI across Singapore’s defence and critical infrastructure sectors. The relationship was formalised at CIDEX 2026.

The rapid adoption of AI has fundamentally changed cybersecurity norms and best practices. In the few months alone, the emergence and exploitation of novel vulnerabilities, rogue AI agent behavior, and LLM-related supply chain attacks, have ushered in a new era in cyber governance and defence.

SentinelOne and DCCOM will explore bringing together the AI-native Singularity™ Platform, SentinelLABS™ AI and threat intelligence research, and training with DCCOM’s own expertise to help defenders evolve their practices and strategies to meet this new reality. As a result, human defenders can benefit from AI-powered security to detect, investigate, and respond to novel threats at machine speed.

Security That Fits Defence Environments

Defence networks need protection that does not depend on a cloud connection. The Singularity Platform supports on-premise and air-gapped deployment, so DCCOM can apply AI-native protection in environments where a cloud connection is not an option. For defenders, that means detection and response that stay inside the network boundary.

Four Areas of Cooperation

The parties will explore partnering in four areas:

- Cybersecurity technology and solutions
- Cyber threat intelligence sharing
- Research and innovation
- Training and capacity building

“Singapore is putting AI at the centre of how it defends itself and runs its critical systems, and the security behind that has to keep pace,” said Andrew Howell, VP, Government Affairs at SentinelOne. “This collaboration allows us to explore ways our platform, our research, and our training can be combined alongside DCCOM's own teams, so defenders can stop attacks at machine speed, including in air-gapped environments, and so more of the people doing that work are trained in Singapore.”

“Our MOU with SentinelOne will facilitate joint collaboration on AI-enabled technologies for cyber operations, for faster threat detection, investigation and response at machine speed,” said Brigadier-General Clarence Cai, Commander DCCOM/Defence Cyber Chief.

About SentinelOne

SentinelOne (NYSE: S) is the leader in AI security, setting the standard for using AI and automation to give defenders a decisive operating advantage. Built for those who secure our world, its platform delivers unified coverage across endpoints, identity, cloud, and AI. Powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence, SentinelOne stops attacks at machine speed, reducing risk and delivering clarity and control to stay one step ahead. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, with teams worldwide, SentinelOne protects nearly one-fifth of the Fortune 500 and hundreds of Global 2000 enterprises. Key Terms

air-gappedtechnical
A system described as air-gapped is physically isolated from public and private networks so it cannot be reached over the internet or company LAN, like a safe kept in a room with no phone line. For investors this matters because air-gapping reduces the risk that critical data, trading algorithms, backups or industrial controls will be accessed or tampered with by hackers, but it can also increase costs and slow information flow compared with connected systems.
llmtechnical
A large language model (LLM) is an advanced computer system trained on vast amounts of written text to understand and generate human-like language, similar to a very fast, well-read assistant that can summarize documents, draft messages, or answer questions. Investors care because LLMs can speed up research, automate customer support, and reduce costs, while also creating new product opportunities and risks around accuracy, bias, and regulatory oversight that can affect a company’s performance.

MESA, AZ / ACCESS Newswire / November 19, 2026 / Medical Care Technologies Inc. (OTCID:MDCE) today announced that it has paused dilution and does not currently plan to resume equity issuance until 2027 when expansion plans and funding are to be re-evaluated in efforts to align with shareholder value and continuing near term revenue. The decision follows the Company's third-quarter results showing a sharp improvement in profitability and accelerating private sales activity at its Infinite Auctions subsidiary.

On November 12, MDCE reported unaudited results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Third-quarter sales revenue rose 13% to $538,981. Gross profit increased 55% to $240,839. Net operating income rose 254% to $192,565, and net income increased 270% to $192,565. For the nine-month period, the Company reported net income of $198,883 compared to a net loss of $145,347 in the prior-year period. Gross profit rose to $332,744. The Company ended the quarter with zero current liabilities and cash of $102,172.

Supporting the decision to pause dilution is revenue generation at Infinite Auctions. Private sales at the subsidiary have already surpassed $300,000 in the fourth quarter. This activity builds on the subsidiary's partnership with a multi-billion-dollar sports card and collectibles company, under which six-figure transaction activity has already occurred. Real Game Used continues to maintain a continuous backlog of customer and auction-brand authentication work through its automated submission system. The Company has also announced that its subsidiaries are managing approximately $20 million in private collectibles assets, with potential net profits contingent on completed sales.

In parallel, technical development continues under MDCE's first paid external software agreement, valued at up to $250,000, covering an integrated web and enterprise platform for inventory and sales workflows. The first payment under that agreement has been initiated. StrainScan Pro enterprise demonstrations remain active. Internal evaluation continues on MDCE Melanoma Scan Beta and the wound-monitoring application, with updated technical results available on the Company's corporate website.

"Shareholders have expressed concern about dilution and this is our response," said Marshall Perkins, CEO of Medical Care Technologies. "The third-quarter results showed net income up 270% and a clear improvement in profitability. Infinite Auctions private sales have already surpassed $300,000 in Q4. That revenue, together with the software agreement now in active development and the ongoing work at our subsidiaries, gives us the ability to pause further equity issuance through 2027. The focus is on building from the commercial activity we already have in motion."

Medical Care Technologies Inc. This feature has also reduced processing turnaround time by approximately 60%, allowing trade contributors to see their matched data even faster.

The Company has a top priority for data quality, and the strong response reflects how closely the company works with its contributors to improve it. Each request draws on what contributors know firsthand about their own customers, and every trade record linked through that knowledge strengthens the data available to everyone in the network. Since many of these contributors are credit and finance teams at Fortune 1000 companies, the network is built on the expertise of seasoned credit professionals managing some of the largest and most complex receivables portfolios in the world. This is the power of an intelligent network the Company will continue to invest in over the next 3 years with the goal of significantly increasing receivables trade volume which currently stands at $3 trillion annually.

The Request Trade Review feature allows our trade contributors to provide additional business context around the customers they work with. For example, if a particular customer is associated with a large privately held company and the trade contributor would like to reflect that association in its record, then the trade contributor can notify the Company to link the two entities. The Company links the accounts receivable to the appropriate business, and any risk score already available on that business then applies to the contributor's account. With broader scored coverage, contributors can see how their accounts are distributed across the Company's proprietary bankruptcy risk models and low, medium, and high risk levels, and how much of their receivables sit within each.

That visibility matters more as business failures stay elevated. U.S. bankruptcy filings for the 12 months ending September 30, 2026 were 33% higher than the 10-year average, according to data from the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts. With a clear view of their exposure, credit teams can review high-risk accounts and take steps to reduce risk, while pursuing growth with lower-risk customers.

"Every account a credit team can't score is a blind spot, but the ones that hurt most are where the largest receivables dollars sit," said Mike Flum, Chief Executive Officer & President of CreditRiskMonitor. "Our clients know their customers better than anyone else, and when they share that context with our expert staff, we can extend scored coverage to the accounts where the most dollars are at stake. There's been strong interest from our trade providers."

This process bolsters the Company's existing procedure of enriching company trade payment histories by engaging in a community-based feedback loop.

How the Trade Contributor Program Works

The Trade Contributor Program is the Company's trade data exchange. Participating companies submit their accounts receivable (A/R) trade file each month, the standardized record of how each customer pays. In return, they receive risk insights and comparative payment data benchmarking, drawn from a network that aggregates $3 trillion in global trade payment data.

Joining the program is simple for companies, especially for those that already share trade data. Organizations that submit A/R trade files to another trade data exchange can generally send the same monthly file to CreditRiskMonitor. File specifications are available in the Company's A/R trade file submission requirements.

All trade file submissions are fully anonymized. Contributor identities are never disclosed, and payment data is reported only in aggregate. The Company maintains SOC 2 compliance, meaning an independent auditor has verified its data security controls.

Request Trade Review is available now to all Trade Contributor Program participants. Companies interested in contributing trade data can learn more at www.creditriskmonitor.com/solutions/trade-contributor-program.

These products help corporate credit and procurement professionals stay ahead of and manage financial risk more quickly, accurately, and cost-effectively. Our subscribers include nearly 40% of the Fortune 1000 and well over a thousand other large corporations worldwide.

To help subscribers prioritize and monitor counterparty financial risk, our SaaS platforms offer the proprietary FRISK® and PAYCE® Scores as well as the FAST Rating, the well-known Altman Z"-Score, agency ratings from key Nationally Recognized Statistical Rating Organizations ("NRSROs"), curated news, and detailed financial spreads & ratios. Our FRISK® and PAYCE® Scores are financial distress classification models that measure a business's probability of bankruptcy within a year. The FRISK® Score also includes a risk signal based on the aggregate research behaviors of our subscribers, who control counterparty access to trade credit at some of the most sophisticated companies in the world. The inclusion of this risk signal boosts the overall accuracy of this bankruptcy analytic by lowering the false positive rate for the riskiest corporations.

Through its Trade Contributor Program, the Company receives monthly confidential accounts receivables data from hundreds of subscribers and non-subscribers, which it parses, processes, aggregates, and reports to summarize the invoice payment behavior of B2B counterparties without disclosing the specific contributors of this information. Founded during World War II to fill a critical supply gap, the longest-running site in BD's network today makes approximately 6.5 million medical devices annually

FRANKLIN LAKES, N.J., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) (NYSE: BDX), a leading global medical technology company, today celebrates the 85th anniversary of its manufacturing site in Glens Falls, New York, highlighting its generations-long role in strengthening American healthcare resilience and partnership in the communities where it operates. Since opening with 35 employees in 1941, the site has grown to about 550 associates producing essential medical technologies across vascular, cardiac, urology and other areas of care that clinicians and patients around the world rely on every day.

The site began as the United States Catheter and Instrument Corporation (USCI), which received the Army-Navy "E" Award for manufacturing performance in 1943. Over the decades, the operation has contributed to advances in catheter-based medicine, including selective angiography and technologies associated with the development of angioplasty.

"Healthcare providers count on us for products that are consistent, high quality and available when patients need them," said Jerome Mascles, vice president of Integrated Supply Chain, Peripheral Intervention, at BD. "For 85 years, the skill and dedication of our associates in Glens Falls have helped us deliver the reliable supply of essential medical technologies that health systems across the US and around the world depend on for care."

Associates, retirees and community leaders gathered today at the Glens Falls site in the Town of Queensbury to celebrate the milestone and recognize the generations of people who have contributed to its 85-year history. Retired New York State Sen. Betty Little, a lifelong area resident, and Glens Falls Mayor Dana Palmer joined the celebration along with other local leaders and special guests.

"This facility has been a cornerstone of the Glens Falls community for 85 years. The skilled people who work here are part of what makes this a great place to live. It's special that something made right here helps patients around the world," Little said.

"Eighty-five years is a long time to keep making products that patients and clinicians depend on, and it happens because of the people who show up here every day. The know-how our associates have built over the years is what keeps our work reliable," said Bob Kelly, Senior Operations Manager at BD's Glens Falls site.

As part of the anniversary celebration, BD donated $10,000 to Open Door Mission, which provides food assistance and shelter for people experiencing homelessness and poverty across the region. Glens Falls associates also support local organizations including Big Brothers Big Sisters of the Southern Adirondacks and The Wait House.

BD's community engagement through Glens Falls extends beyond the region. Since 2024, BD has provided $60,000 to Let's Share the Sun, a New York-based nonprofit supporting solar installations in underserved communities, including projects that give Glens Falls students hands-on experience.

Past results confirmed and new mineralized intercepts in new lithologies

TORONTO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Safi Silver Corp. (TSX-V: SF; OTCPK: PNTZF) (“Safi Silver” or the “Company”) provides an update on its ongoing 2026 drilling program at the Addana Project (the “Project” or “Addana”) in Morocco, reporting additional silver mineralization at Addana Southwest and sulphide intersections at Antenna Hill, the Project's primary exploration target.

Figure 1: Addana SW: drilled and planned holes. Traces are horizontal projections at −55°. UTM Zone 29N

At Addana Southwest, drilling has intersected 146 g/t silver in the lower sandstone unit beneath the graphitic schist, adding to previously reported silver mineralization approximately 250 metres away. At Antenna Hill, the first two drill holes have intersected sulphide mineralization, including semi-massive sulphide bands within the graphitic schist and disseminated sulphides in the underlying quartzite. Assays from Antenna Hill are pending.

The drilling is providing additional information on the distribution of mineralization across different geological units and helping to refine targets for continued exploration.

Highlights

  • Silver mineralization in the lower sandstone at Addana SW: Drill hole SW2026-06 returned 146 g/t silver over 0.8 metre, from 160.0 to 160.8 metres, in sandstone beneath the graphitic schist. Together with the previously reported intersection of 35.52 g/t silver over 1.0 metre in SW2026-07, approximately 250 metres away, the results provide evidence of silver mineralization within the lower sandstone unit.
  • Confirmation of previously reported high-grade silver: A repeat analysis of the high-grade sample from SW2026-02 returned 608 g/t silver over 1.0 metre, compared with the original result of 657 g/t silver.
  • Sulphides intersected in both Antenna Hill drill holes: AH-01 and AH-02 encountered sulphides, predominantly pyrite, in the lower part of the graphitic schist, including semi-massive sulphide bands. In AH-02, sulphides also occur in the underlying quartzite. Assays are pending.
  • Drilling beneath historic workings at Antenna Hill: AH-01 was completed to 158.8 metres, while AH-02 had advanced beyond 229 metres as of November 17, 2026, and is approved to a target depth of 300 metres.

Addana Southwest

Drilling at Addana Southwest has identified silver mineralization in both the upper sandstone and the lower sandstone unit beneath the graphitic schist.

Drill hole SW2026-06 returned 146 g/t silver over 0.8 metre, from 160.0 to 160.8 metres, in the lower sandstone, hosted in sandstone containing millimetric quartz veinlets. This intersection is approximately 250 metres from the previously reported 35.52 g/t silver over 1.0 metre in drill hole SW2026-07, also within the lower sandstone unit. SW2026-06 (collar 545091 E, 3206253 N; azimuth 210°, dip −55°) was completed to a depth of 180.7 metres.

The silver values returned from the sandstone beneath the graphitic schist are of geological interest. The lower sandstone is not exposed at surface and was not accessed by historical mining. Its identification at depth adds another geological horizon for the Company to investigate as drilling progresses.

Further drilling will be required to establish the geometry, extent and continuity of mineralization across the different rock units.

The previously reported high-grade silver sample from SW2026-02 was also re-analysed by gravimetric fire assay on a new pulp from the coarse reject, returning 608 g/t silver over 1.0 metre, compared with the original four-acid ICP assay of 657 g/t silver. The repeat result confirms the high silver grade in the sampled interval. The sample was collected from broken drill core within a fault zone between 6.0 and 7.0 metres depth. The geological source and continuity of these silver values remain to be established. Additional analyses on this sample are in progress.

Gold fire-assay results for 52 samples from SW2026-01, SW2026-02 and SW2026-07 were all below 0.05 g/t Au. Further gold analyses at lower detection limits are in progress.

Antenna Hill

Drilling moved from Addana Southwest to Antenna Hill, the primary target at the Addana Project, in late October. The first two drill holes have intersected sulphide mineralization within the lower part of the graphitic schist, including semi-massive sulphide bands. Drill hole AH-02 has also intersected sulphides in the underlying quartzite.

The two holes were drilled from a bench among the historic pits. AH-02 was collared approximately 120 metres east-southeast of AH-01, on the same section and in the same direction, to test beneath AH-01 and the historic workings. Previously reported grab samples of historic waste material at Antenna Hill returned up to 564 g/t silver.

AH-01 was completed to a depth of 158.8 metres, where difficult ground conditions resulted in the loss of drill rods. This is interpreted as a possible historic underground working, although this has not been confirmed. If confirmed, it would place historic artisanal mining more than 100 metres below the bench.

AH-02 had advanced beyond 229 metres as of November 17, 2026, and is approved to a target depth of 300 metres. The hole is intended to test the full geological sequence beneath the historic workings.

Both holes encountered the sequence expected from published district geology, comprising sandstone and schist in the upper part of the holes overlying graphitic schist. In AH-02, the base of the graphitic schist was intersected at approximately 154 metres, followed by the underlying quartzite.

Sulphide Mineralization

In AH-02, the final metre of graphitic schist, between 153 and 154 metres, contains irregular clots of millimetre-sized sulphide grains, visually estimated to represent 10–20% sulphides. The first 35 centimetres of the underlying quartzite also contains fine disseminated sulphides, a texture not previously observed at Addana Southwest, followed by clean quartzite.

At approximately 154.7 metres, a sulphide grain approximately one centimetre in size, including chalcopyrite, was observed along a fracture in the quartzite.

Semi-massive sulphide bands were also intersected higher in the graphitic schist. In AH-02, a band approximately 10 centimetres thick was observed at 144 metres, visually estimated to contain 45–55% sulphides. AH-01 intersected a similar band at approximately 154 metres and ended in graphitic schist without reaching the underlying quartzite.

The sulphides have been identified visually as predominantly pyrite. Their silver and base-metal content will be determined through laboratory analysis. Sulphide descriptions and visual estimates are based on core logging and are not substitutes for assay results.

Next Steps

  • Continue drilling AH-02 toward its approved target depth of 300 metres.
  • Expedite laboratory analysis of sulphide-bearing intervals from AH-01 (150–158.8 metres) and AH-02 (141–178 metres).
  • Submit Antenna Hill core samples for silver, gold and base-metal analysis, with sampling focused on sulphide-bearing, veined and altered intervals.
  • Complete the suspended SW2026-05 drill hole at Addana Southwest, which was stopped at 50 metres when the rig moved to Antenna Hill.
  • Report additional drilling and assay updates as results become available.

Jed Richardson, President and CEO of Safi Silver, commented, “We are continuing to build our understanding of the geology at Addana through drilling at both Southwest and Antenna Hill. At Southwest, the intersection of 146 g/t silver in the lower sandstone, beneath the graphitic schist, provides further evidence of silver mineralization at depth and identifies another geological horizon for follow-up. At Antenna Hill, we are seeing sulphide mineralization within the graphitic schist and extending into the underlying quartzite. These observations are helping us evaluate the mineralized structures and their relationship to the surrounding geology. We look forward to advancing the drilling program and receiving the pending assays from Antenna Hill.”

Sampling, Analyses and Security

Core was sampled at nominal 1.0 metre (HQ) and 1.5 metre (NQ) intervals, adjusted to geological contacts, and sawed in half. One half was sent for analysis and the other retained on site. Samples remained in Company custody until dispatched to the laboratory.

Samples were prepared and analysed by AFRILAB (African Laboratory for Mining & Environment), Marrakech, Morocco, independent of the Company and accredited to CALA ISO/IEC 17025 (No. 1005059). Samples were crushed and pulverised (PM-PRE.MO/ANA/015) and analysed by four-acid digestion with ICP finish (PRE.MO/ANA/038; silver detection limit 1 g/t). Gold was analysed by fire assay with atomic absorption finish (PRE.MO/ANA/001; detection limit 0.05 g/t). The re-assay of sample 93209 was by gravimetric fire assay (PRE.MO/ANA/035) on a new pulp prepared from the coarse reject (certificate R-10326-26).

Blanks, certified reference materials and duplicates (approximately 15% of samples) were inserted. Blanks showed no significant contamination, and certified reference materials, pulp duplicates and laboratory repeats returned consistent results. The Company is reviewing sample handling with the laboratory. The re-assay of sample 93209, made on a new split of the coarse reject, agrees with the original assay within 7%.

Data Verification

Drilling, core logging, sampling and the insertion of control samples at Addana Southwest and Antenna Hill were supervised by Alexandr Beloborodov, P.Geo. (OGQ #1637), President of ABG Exploration Inc., a geological consultant to the Company.

Qualified Person

The scientific and technical information in this news release has been reviewed and approved by Dr. Andreas Rompel, Pr.Sci.Nat., FSAIMM, Chief Exploration Officer of Safi Silver, a Qualified Person as defined by National Instrument 43-101. Dr. Rompel is not independent of the Company.

About Safi Silver

Safi Silver Corp. is a publicly traded Canadian exploration and development company with a core focus on copper and silver holdings in mining-friendly African jurisdictions. In Morocco, the Company holds the Addana Project, which hosts silver-bearing polymetallic veins, and the Silver Hill project, a sedimentary copper prospect under evaluation. In Namibia, Safi Silver holds the Kalahari Copperbelt Project.

  • JALL brings together core global developed and emerging equities in a single active ETF, offering a simple way to access global diversification
  • The product expands J.P. Morgan Asset Management's research enhanced product range, leveraging the team's 40-year, time-tested fundamental research and disciplined construction process

NEW YORK, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- J.P. Morgan Asset Management today announced the launch of the JPMorgan All Country Research Enhanced Equity ETF (JALL) on NYSE Arca. JALL expands the firm's research enhanced suite by offering a single, actively managed ETF for core global equity exposure across developed and emerging markets. The fund is seeded with $250 million at launch by FM, a leading commercial property insurer. As the largest issuer of active ETFs globally1, J.P. Morgan Asset Management continues to build a broad, differentiated active ETF range designed to help clients diversify portfolios and access institutional-quality active management.

"We have seen investors increasing allocations to active ETFs and international equities at high rates this year as opportunities are broadening across regions, sectors and styles," said Travis Spence, Global Head of ETFs at J.P. Morgan Asset Management. "As part of our continued commitment to expanding our active ETF platform, this launch seeks to give clients a simple way to diversify portfolios across the global equity market in a single wrapper."

"As a long-term institutional investor, we see value in strategies that seek incremental alpha while maintaining the characteristics and diversification of a broad market portfolio. JALL brings this approach to global equities through an ETF structure," said Sanjay Chawla, Executive Vice President and Chief Investment Officer, FM. "Our experience with J.P. Morgan's research enhanced approach has given us confidence in the team's disciplined investment process, focus on fundamental stock selection and prudent risk management." 

According to J.P. Morgan Asset Management's 4Q 2026 Guide to ETFs, active ETF flows have accelerated in recent years: total flows into active ETFs in 2025 were over 18 times flows into active ETFs in 2019. Moreover, year-to-date 2026 flows have already outpaced full-year 2025, reaching approximately $590 billion. As a portion of international equity ETF flows, active strategies increased to represent over 30% year-to-date 2026, underscoring investor interest in these products for global diversification.

JALL targets the global large stock blend segment, one of the largest active equity ETF categories, delivering core exposure through a differentiated, actively managed research-backed process. It invests primarily in equity securities of companies in developed and emerging markets, leveraging insights from a global team of fundamental research analysts located around the world.

Two-day event convenes senior management and institutional investors across aerospace, defense, chemicals, transportation, homebuilders and diversified industrials sectors

NEW YORK, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RBC Capital Markets concluded its Global Industrials Conference, bringing together senior management teams from more than 90 companies and institutional investors across the industrials sector. The two-day, in-person event, held November 16–17, 2026, in New York, featured analyst-moderated breakout sessions, one-on-one meetings and keynote presentations focused on short-cycle industrial demand, datacenter power infrastructure, trade policy and tariffs and the impact of the 2026 midterm elections on defense and infrastructure spending.

Key Takeaways from RBC Research Analysts

Day 1 Takeaways:

  • Short-cycle industrial demand is broadening: The recovery that began in early 2026 is accelerating, with sector growth excluding HVAC and electrical names reaching 5.4% year-over-year in 3Q26, up from 4.4% in 2Q26 and 2.6% in 1Q26.
  • Homebuilders and building products face a cautious tone: Residential housing demand has softened notably over the past two months, with builders cutting back on starts and land spend. Heavy commercial construction remains a pocket of strength.
  • Aerospace and defense aftermarket dynamics remain strong: StandardAero reported no signs of a slowdown in near-term aftermarket demand, while the Leap engine outlook remains very strong with an accelerated ramp expected in the 2028–2030 period.
  • Democratic midterm sweep creates mixed policy signals: The 2026 midterms resulted in larger-than-expected Democratic victories, viewed as incrementally negative for defense stocks but positive for aerospace, with potential caps on defense spending growth near FY2026 levels.
  • Robotaxi and autonomous mobility remain in early innings: Regulatory approval is the binding constraint on fleet expansion, with OEMs creating partnerships across the downstream value chain. Tesla is positioned to build a compelling long-term ride-hailing business as its fleet scales.

Day 2 Takeaways:

  • Honeywell International emphasized its leading position as a pure-play automation company with durable secular tailwinds in physical AI, global energy investment and datacenter buildout, supported by nearly $19 billion in backlog, datacenter orders up 100% year-over-year, and LNG equipment sold out through 2029.
  • General Motors is increasingly differentiating itself from traditional OEMs: 2027 consensus EBIT looks de-risked, with commodity and DRAM headwinds offset by warranty benefits, truck pricing and smaller EV losses. Its Super Cruise and OnStar software business could be transformational over time, and GM's small exposure to China sets it apart from other automakers. A strong capital return profile, including a new buyback plan, supports the case for a multiple re-rating as GM moves to the Nasdaq.
  • Karman Holdings reiterated confidence in its 20–25% organic growth outlook, with potential for incremental long-term agreements in autonomous systems after four 2026 agreements. Management was confident in a recovery in space and launch revenues in 2027 and continues to target approximately two acquisitions per year while maintaining ~30% adjusted EBITDA margins.
  • Manufactured housing remains the one bright spot of growth: SKY continues to see solid near-term demand and pricing, with a backlog of approximately $500 million supporting its F3Q revenue guidance of +8–10%. Longer-term, management sees meaningful share gain opportunities supported by the ROAD to Housing Act, captive retail integration, and digital initiatives.
  • Schneider Electric provided confidence in synergy achievement and greater peace-of-mind regarding the resilience and security of the datacenter growth story, with the overall message supportive of the view that the recent sell-off in the share looks overdone.
  • Data center and technology demand outlook is strong going into 2027: Legence continues to see strong demand signals from clients, underpinned by backlog growth and RFP pipeline. The company works in the mid- to late-phase of data center construction cycles, reducing the risk of project cancellations or postponements.
  • PPG Industries maintained its FY26 EPS guidance of $7.90–$8.10, with Q4 expected to see low-single-digit organic growth driven by aerospace, packaging, and refinish strength, offset by soft auto OEM.

The conference featured presentations from:

  • IDEX Corporation: Eric Ashleman, Chief Executive Officer; Sean Gillen, Chief Financial Officer (moderated by Jeffrey Reive, RBC Capital Markets)

  • GFL Environmental: Patrick Dovigi, Founder & Chief Executive Officer; Luke Pelosi, EVP & Chief Financial Officer (moderated by Ken Herbert, RBC Capital Markets)
  • StandardAero: Paul McElhinney, Chief Executive Officer; Dan Satterfield, Chief Financial Officer (moderated by Ken Herbert, RBC Capital Markets)

The breadth of discussions reflects strong industrial end markets in data center and energy infrastructure, space and commercial aerospace engines. The themes that emerged across both days point to durable secular tailwinds that we believe can support a normalization in investor sentiment."
— Mark Odendahl, Global Co-Head of Research, RBC Capital Markets

"Robust fundamentals and multi-year secular trends can support a normalization in investor sentiment and positioning, despite the ongoing challenges of tariff and inflation uncertainty, supply chain disruption and geopolitical risk."
— RBC Capital Markets Global Industrials Research Team

"North American trucking is experiencing an unusual dynamic as freight demand remains subdued while capacity continues to tighten. Volume recovery remains elusive but green shoots are emerging."

ATHENS, Greece, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TEN, Ltd (NYSE: TEN) (the “Company”) today reported results (unaudited) for the nine months and the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

NINE MONTHS 2026 SUMMARY RESULTS
During the first nine months of 2026, TEN, with an average in-the-water fleet of 63 vessels, generated gross revenues of $851 million, a near $274 million increase from the nine months of 2025.

The resulting net income for the first nine-months of 2026 reached $403 million equivalent to $12.69 per share compared to $2.75 per share in the nine-month period of 2025, representing a gross increase of 355%.

Operating income during the 2026 nine-month period and inclusive of a $94 million capital gain from the sale of four vessels, rose to $467 million from $171 million in the corresponding period of 2025, which also included capital gains of $12.5 million.

Adjusted EBITDA for the first nine months of 2026 was at $510 million from $289 million in the first nine months of 2025.

Despite having 12 vessels on scheduled dry dock, one vessel undergoing repairs and some on repositing voyages during the first nine months of 2026, fleet utilization remained high at 95.5%.

The average Time Charter Equivalent (TCE) rate per vessel per day for the nine months of 2026 rose to $45,170, compared with $30,703 in the nine months of 2025, representing a 47% increase, reflecting the continued strength of the tanker markets.

Total operating expenses per vessel per day remained at a still competitive $10,664 in the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

Depreciation and amortization in the nine months ended September 30, 2026, totaled $135 million from $126 million in the corresponding 2025 period, attributable to the operation of a slightly larger fleet consisting of newer and larger class vessels.

TEN’s cash balances at the end of September 2026, stood at a healthy $533.5 million, $269 million higher than the cash levels at the end of September 2025

Total bank debt as of September 30, 2026, was $2.0 billion from $1.8 billion at September 30, 2025, reflecting new loans associated with vessels entering the fleet.

Interest and finance costs for the first nine months of 2026 amounted to $65.7 million, about $7.0 million lower than the level recorded in the first nine-months of 2025, as a result of decreased spreads attained from banks for new or refinanced loans and lower global interest rates. Interest income rose to f $10.4 million in the 2026 nine-month period compared to $7.7 million received in the 2025 nine-month period.

Q3 2026 SUMMARY RESULTS
With an average fleet of 63 vessels, TEN’s gross revenues during the third quarter of 2026 approximated $300 million, an increase of $113 million, or 61%, over the corresponding 2025 period.

Net income in the third quarter of 2026 reached $174.5 million (inclusive of the capital gains mentioned above), equivalent to $5.57 per share, from $1.05 per share in the third quarter of 2025 which also recorded the aforementioned capital gains. A 431% increase.

Operating income during the third quarter of 2026, inclusive of $56.2 million capital gain from the sale of three vessels in the summer of 2026, settled at $194.5 million from $60.5 million in the equivalent quarter of 2025, which included capital gains of $8.9 million obtained from the sale of three vessels

Adjusted EBITDA for the third quarter of 2026 was at $185.4 million, 94% higher from the 2025 third quarter level.

Average TCE rate per vessel per day in the third quarter of 2026 reached $48,615, 59% higher than the 2025 equivalent period, supported by high fleet utilization rates of nearly 94%.

Operating expenses per vessel per day in the third quarter of 2026 were $11,394.

Depreciation and amortization expenses during the third quarter of 2026 were in line with the increased number of vessels in the fleet at $44.8 million, just $2.3 million higher than the 2025 third quarter levels.

Consistent with the first nine-months trend, interest and finance costs in the third quarter of 2026 decreased by $1.4 million from the corresponding 2025 period to $22.3 million, benefiting from lower borrowing spreads and lower global interest rates, while interest income totaled $4.8 million.

SUBSEQUENT EVENTS & OTHERS
On September 29, 2026, TEN exercised its right to repurchase the 2022-built LNG carrier Tenergy, currently under a five-year finance lease, at a significant discount to fair market value. The acquisition will be completed upon the expiration of the lease in January 2027 and will be financed in its entirety through funds obtained from an international banking institution on attractive terms.

On October 26, 2026, TEN announced its authorization to commence an up to $150 million buyback program covering both common and preferred shares. The timing of any share purchases of any type, the prices and the exact number of shares to be purchased will depend on prevailing market conditions, cash balances and other uses of capital.

TEN is evaluating the possibility of applying to list its common shares on the Main Board of the Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited (the “SGX-ST”). TEN’s common shares are currently listed and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) and would continue to be primarily listed and traded on NYSE.  No final decision or commitment has been made as to the timing, terms or conditions of any such listing on the SGX-ST.

CORPORATE AFFAIRS

On October 26, 2026, TEN announced a doubling of its first 2027 semi-annual common stock dividend to $1.00 per share, up from $0.50 per share in the 2026 comparable period. The dividend is scheduled for payment on January 20, 2027, to shareholders of record as of January 12, 2027. For the entire 2026, TEN paid common shareholders a total of $1.50 per share in dividends.

Since the Company’s NYSE listing in 2002, TEN has consistently demonstrated its commitment to reward shareholders, and will have distributed, until the end of 2026 over $1.0 billion in aggregate common and preferred share dividends.

The Company’s 9.25% Series E Preferred Shares become redeemable at the election of the Company on May 28, 2027, and the Company currently expects that it may elect to redeem, all or a portion of, such Series E Preferred Shares on the above stated date. This disclosure does not constitute a notice of redemption, and there can be no assurance as to the amount, if any, of the Series E Preferred Shares that will be redeemed.

CORPORATE STRATEGY

As tanker market fundamentals, in terms of supply and demand remain healthy and continue to be supported by trade dislocations stemming from geopolitics, TEN benefits from the very strong conditions evident both in the freight market and the firm asset values.

Accordingly, TEN continues to capture the market upside through spot and profit-sharing contracts, while pursuing long-term charter coverage at today’s high levels.

With cash balances well in excess of half a billion dollars, and $3.6 billion of future revenues, management remains committed to evaluating accretive growth opportunities across the various sectors in which TEN operates, while continuing to focus on the divestment of older assets where demand remains strong.

“TEN is navigating through this unprecedented environment with a diversified and high-quality fleet, positioned to capture market upside by securing firm forward revenues and providing shareholders with attractive returns. In parallel, it is continuing its dynamic 20-vessel newbuilding program,” stated Mr. George Saroglou, COO and President of TEN. “The doubling of the 2027 first semi-annual dividend, the $150 million buyback program together with the divestment of older tonnage highlights management’s intention to use TEN’s healthy and growing cash balances for the long-term benefit of the Company, and its shareholders,” To this end, and having been pioneers in the capital markets with a first public listing back in 1993 on the Oslo Bors, and in 2002 on the NYSE, management currently evaluates a possible secondary listing on the Singapore Exchange (SGX), in order to position the Company in the growing Asian capital market going forward” Mr. Saroglou concluded.
